the ANF gene is induced by acute pressure overload, and that this is mediated through the AP1-like element in its proximal promoter.
a cis-acting element within the atrial nariuretic factor gene promoter, containing an activator protein- 1-like site, is primarily responsible for the acute pressure overload induction of this gene.
a cis-acting element in the ANF promoter is responsible for its induction in pressure overload.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of cis-acting elements that confer inducibility and tissue-specific expression of the ANF and ANP gene.
the molecular regulation of the ANF and beta-myosin heavy gene expression in response to pressure overload and the role of the AP1 and CRE in the control of ANF gene transcription.
the regulation of the ANF (ANP) gene in the heart.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the AP1-like sequence is the cis-acting element responsible for the overload-inducible expression of the ANF.
the AP1-like element is necessary but not sufficient for the inducibility by pressure overload.
the ANF gene is under the regulation of a complex array of cis-acting regulatory elements that include the AP-1-like element.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the AP1-like element is the cis-acting element that confers inducibility of ANF in response to pressure overload, but that the AP1 proteins are not responsible for the induction.
an AP1-like sequence is responsible for the inducibility, but the AP1 proteins are not the major transcription factors responsible for this response.
a unique cis element in the rat ANF gene promoter is responsible for its induction by acute pressure overload.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a unique cis element, which is not a consensus AP1 site, is required for the induction of the ANFT promoter by acute pressure overload.
the ANF gene is regulated by a unique AP1-like element, which confers inducibility to acute pressure overload in vivo.
the AP1-like element in the ANF promoter is necessary and sufficient to confer the inducibility to acute pressure overload of the ANF and heterologous promoters.
